title: WARNING!  Don’t Let this *PAYROLLS TRAP* Steal Your Gains Tomorrow!

macro_themes.view: Good news is bad news: a strong NFP print hurts given a possible Fed rate hike in October; expect traps around range edges.

calls.quote: Bulls definitely have the edge right now, but be ready for traps around the edges on the Nasdaq.

calls.condition: Range primed to rotate higher; a measured move down into the 7654 gap area would be a bear-trap buy
calls.reason: Middle range primed to rotate up, but open gap/wick near 7654 begs to be partly filled on NFP Friday.
